t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Different coloured gnomes will provide different amounts of points (between 0-9). There's two groups; group one - red, purple, blue, and pink; group two - orange, brown, yellow, green. One group will always give more points, but it is not certain which one at any given time. If 1x is lower than three, then the other would have given you more but it's not certain, it is a risk. if it is 5x and gives 20, the other group would give more, but again it's not certain.

vb_textbox.text: There appears to be two groups; group one - red, pink, blue, and purple; group two - orange, brown, yellow, and green. if the screen shows 1x, you are better off picking the gnome that belongs to the colours in group one. If it is 5x, you are better off choosing the gnome from the second group. However, it is very hit and miss. I did fin that generally brown had higher pay outs, while orange tended to have lower pay outs, in general. This is not exact however, and it sometimes ends up giving you 0 or a low score.
